cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I raised my arm when you did. Concede that ball was out; I'm not asking you to give back the match.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was shading my eyes. Neither of us saw where it landed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, watching the line. Just withdraw your claim that it was in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you leave the final score alone if I call it uncertain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Mark that ball 'uncertain'; leave the match score as it is.
